comment: Startup JSON budget (P4-05): decoded bytes of the committed static JSON/GeoJSON files Morro Bay's map fetches with no interaction until the network is quiet, with live feeds stubbed (scripts/measure_startup.mjs --stub). Live feeds (/api/*, /feeds/*, the ArcGIS MPA query) move with upstream data and are reported, not budgeted. max_bytes is the measured value + 10%. The guide's target (all startup JSON) is 400 KB; lower this as later slices cut more. #617 (2026-10-12) cut 2,503,888 to 663,384 bytes: the map reads the region's startup copies (src/skippercast/platform/startup_forms.py) of the atlas, the search plans and the shoreline. What remains is the protected areas (always on), the atlas marks the first view draws, the overview shoreline and the region files. CI6-01B (2026-10-20) adds dist/regions/<id>/land-water.json (5,150 bytes for Morro Bay), which the brief loads to check ranked places; land-water-lines.json (278,928 bytes) loads only when a candidate falls in a mixed cell of that index, which none of today's ranked marks do. SC-LAUNCH-3 (2026-11-02): LeadRules loadRegs now also reads /data/regulations.json (48,656 bytes) and /data/home-ports.json (4,796 bytes) at startup, which takes the measurement from 722,669 to 776,121 bytes (+53,452, exactly those two files); max_bytes is that measurement + 10%, rounded up (853,734), so static_bytes now records it. SC1938-06 (2026-11-03): loadRegs reads the region's startup copy regions/morro-bay/regulations-startup.json (23,972 bytes, startup_forms.py) instead of /data/regulations.json (48,656 bytes), which takes the measurement from 776,121 to 751,437 bytes (-24,684); max_bytes is that measurement + 10%, rounded up (826,581), by the same rule; target_bytes is unchanged.

precache.comment: Service-worker precache budgets (#422 FE-51 follow-up), checked by scripts/check_client.mjs after the Vite build: raw bytes of every file precache.json lists. `install` is what every visitor's worker stores (assets and static files; the shell pages are not counted). `pack_shell` is the v2 app shell an offline pack stores when someone saves a region (precache.json `v2`: MapLibre, its worker, the app and the glyphs). Each max is the 2026-10-18 measurement (build a257bf69dd: 400,678 and 2,532,577 bytes) + 10%; lower them as slices cut more. BF-saved-spots (2026-11-03): main was already over pack_shell (2,787,245 B against 2,785,835 B) before this change; the saved-spots view in dist/account.js and the merged BF-closures-everywhere changes take the build to 2,797,378 B, and pack_shell_raw_max is that measurement + 10%, rounded up (3,077,116), by the same rule. SC0707-06 (2026-11-04): first run and Your limits read the app catalogue through web/boat-entry.ts, so the shared place chunk now carries the i18n module and the catalogue (10,556 to 57,204 bytes), which takes the install precache from 438,907 to 485,275 B; install_raw_max is that measurement + 10%, rounded up (533803), by the same rule. pack_shell_raw_max is unchanged. SC0707-10 (2026-11-05): the planner and Trip words join the shared catalogue, which takes the install precache from 485,275 to 576,613 B; install_raw_max is that measurement + 10%, rounded up (634275), by the same rule. SC1352-02 (2026-11-05): the water-temperature and offline layer status copy joins the catalogue (web/map/status-copy.ts), which takes the pack shell from 2,797,378 to 3,088,467 B on the merged build (the plan, tour and preset words and the earlier catalogue units are in that figure); pack_shell_raw_max is that measurement + 10%, rounded up (3,397,314), by the same rule. SC0922-12 (2026-11-05): the saved-trip alerts sheet words join the shared catalogue, which takes the install precache from under 634,275 B to 642,919 B; install_raw_max is that measurement + 10%, rounded up (707211), by the same rule. SC1352-03 (2026-11-05): the current, swell and wind layer status copy joins the catalogue, which takes the install precache to 660,494 B on the merged build (the SC0922-12 words are in that figure); install_raw_max is that measurement + 10%, rounded up (726544), by the same rule. SC1137-05 (2026-11-05): the Where to look ranking words join the catalogue and the brief's ranking-copy resolver, which takes the install precache from under 726,544 to 729,439 B and the app's initial JavaScript from under 358,400 to 361,834 B gzipped on the merged build; install_raw_max and the app js_gzip_max are those measurements + 10%, rounded up (802383 and 398018), by the same rule. SC1722-06 (2026-11-10): the phone dialog and Limits save-action words join the catalogue, which takes the pack shell to 3,397,411 B on the merged build, 97 B over; pack_shell_raw_max moves to 3,400,000 (a 2,589 B margin), not the 10% rule, to keep the ceiling close. SC1407-13 (2026-11-10): the plan-date rule and landing layer dot words join the catalogue, which takes the pack shell to 3,399,818 B on the merged build with SC1722-06; pack_shell_raw_max stays 3,400,000 (a 182 B margin). SC1407-13 (2026-11-10, after merging newer main): the merged build is 3,400,144 B, 144 B over; pack_shell_raw_max moves to 3,403,000 (a 2,856 B margin), not the 10% rule, to keep the ceiling close. SC1722-01 (2026-11-10, after merging main): the failed-forecast words join the catalogue and the brief's failed-read note, which takes the merged build to 3,405,353 B, 2,353 B over; pack_shell_raw_max moves to 3,408,000 (a 2,647 B margin), not the 10% rule, to keep the ceiling close. MAIN-RED (2026-11-10): the Save button of the trip-alerts dialog gets its own hover colour (web/app/account.css), which takes the pack shell from 3,407,935 to 3,408,077 B on main, 77 B over; pack_shell_raw_max moves to 3,411,000 (a 2,923 B margin), not the 10% rule, to keep the ceiling close. SC1925-04 (2026-11-10, after merging main with MAIN-RED): the account-created confirmation words join the catalogue and dist/account.js, which takes the merged build to 3,408,564 B, inside the 3,411,000 ceiling (a 2,436 B margin); pack_shell_raw_max is unchanged. SC1407-05 (2026-11-10, after merging main with SC1925-04): the dock-selection preview and its Updating words join the app and catalogue, which takes the merged build to 3,411,358 B, 358 B over; pack_shell_raw_max moves to 3,414,000 (a 2,642 B margin), not the 10% rule, to keep the ceiling close. RF1925-5 (2026-11-10, after merging main with SC1407-05): the location-permission-denied words join the catalogue and the landing port input, which takes the merged build to 3,414,506 B, 506 B over; pack_shell_raw_max moves to 3,417,000 (a 2,494 B margin), not the 10% rule, to keep the ceiling close. SC1922-04 (2026-11-10, after merging main with RF1925-5): the preview-region disclosure words join the catalogue and the app's masthead, time dock and Where to look, which takes the merged build to 3,418,758 B, 1,758 B over; pack_shell_raw_max moves to 3,421,000 (a 2,242 B margin), not the 10% rule, to keep the ceiling close.
